column_description: BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, unique ID for each record of sensitivity details.
CHAR(20) for overall environmental sensitivity (possible values: 'Low', 'High', 'Medium').
TEXT detailing humidity requirements or maximum humidity tolerance (possible values: 'Medium', 'High', 'Low').
VARCHAR(100) indicating susceptibility to pollutants (possible values: 'High', 'Medium', 'Low').
TEXT describing vulnerability to pests (possible values: 'High', 'Low', 'Medium').
VARCHAR(50) specifying special packaging needs (possible values: 'High', 'Low', 'Medium').
VARCHAR(120) noting special display requirements (possible values: 'Low', 'High', 'Medium').
